enchantments.tooltip: +6 Enhancement Bonus: +6 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.

Maiming: This weapon has a twisted haft or grip and spikes along its blade, head, or point. Whenever you score a critical hit with this weapon it deals an amount of extra untyped damage depending on its critical multiplier: x2 - 1 to 6, x3 - 2 to 12, x4 - 3 to 18.

children.tooltip: Insightful Combat Mastery +5: +5 Insight bonus to the DC to resist the character's Trip, Improved Trip, Sunder, Improved Sunder, Stunning Blow, and Stunning Fist attempts.
Shatter +10: This effect gives a +10 Enhancement bonus to the DC to resist the character's Sunder and Improved Sunder attempts.
Stunning +10: +10 Enhancement bonus to the DC of character's Stunning Blow and Stunning Fist attempts.
Vertigo +10: This effect gives a +10 Enhancement bonus to the DC to resist the character's Trip and Improved Trip attempts.
Tendon Slice 10%: This effect gives a 10% chance to Hamstring the target for each attack that does damage.

enchantments.tooltip: Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
